## [JOYROOM PODIX PR70 power bank launches on Kickstarter](https://camerajabber.com/photography-news/joyroom-podix-pr70-power-bank-launches-on-kickstarter/)
*Camera Jabber* | 14/07/2026 | Score: 1.00
Tags: photography, camera

> High-capacity power banks may not be the most glamorous photography accessories, but they&#8217;re becoming increasingly essential for anyone working away from mains power. Whether you&#8217;re charging mirrorless cameras, drones, LED lights, laptops or smartphones, a high-output battery pack can quickly become one of the most valuable pieces of kit in your bag. JOYROOM is aiming squarely at that audience with the new PODIX PR70, a 240W power bank that launches on Kickstarter on 14 July. Designed for creators, travellers, remote workers and heavy device users, it combines high-power USB-C charging with dual TFT displays that provide real-time charging information. The headline figure is its 240W combined output. That&#8217;s enough power to fast-charge many modern USB-C laptops while simultaneously topping up cameras, phones or other accessories, making the PR70 considerably more versatile than the average portable battery.
